items.title: Hackers Are Using Real Dell and Staples Emails to Make Their Scams Look Legitimate
items.description: Hackers are abusing genuine Dell and Staples order emails to make fake purchase alerts look credible. Instead of sending a forged message, they place scam instructions inside order details that trusted retail systems deliver, pushing recipients toward phone numbers controlled by the attackers. The emails describe expensive purchases that recipients may not recognize. Their aim […] The post…
